plugins.name: context-diagramming
plugins.description: Produce system context diagram â highest-level view with system as single box, external entities (person / user-group / software-system / organization) around it, labeled data + interaction flows, and explicit in-scope / out-of-scope. Supports C4 Level 1 (default), classic context diagram, DFD Level 0 styles. Mermaid flowchart with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: use-case-writing
plugins.description: Write formal UML-style use cases (Cockburn conventions). Brief / casual / fully-dressed formats. Per UC: primary actor + supporting actors, stakeholders & interests, preconditions, postconditions, trigger, numbered main success scenario, alternate flows indexed to steps, exception flows, special requirements, frequency, priority. Cockburn level (summary / user-goal / subfunction). UML use-case diagram. Mermaid with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: state-machine-diagramming
plugins.description: Domain-entity state machine modeling. Distinct from UI state-transition-mapping: this is the business lifecycle of entities (Order / User / Subscription / Document / Claim). Per state: invariants + allowed/disallowed ops + entry/exit effects. Per transition: trigger + guard + effect + rollback + idempotency. Flat / hierarchical (sub-states) / parallel (orthogonal regions). Transition matrix + explicit invalid transitions + side-effect catalog. Mermaid stateDiagram-v2 with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: decision-table-creation
plugins.description: Express complex business rules as decision tables. Limited-entry (Y/N) / extended-entry (valued) / mixed. Per rule: condition values â actions. Verifies completeness (all combinations covered or impossible), consistency (no overlapping rules with different outcomes), redundancy (no duplicates). Explicit default / otherwise rule. Optional DMN XML emission with hit policy (UNIQUE / FIRST / PRIORITY / ANY / COLLECT). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: data-dictionary-definition
plugins.description: Structured catalog of data entities and attributes. Per entity: source of truth, owner, sensitivity, retention, volume. Per attribute: type (string / integer / decimal / boolean / date / timestamp / enum / reference / json / array), format, nullable, constraints, source, mandatory PII classification (none / identifier / quasi-identifier / sensitive / health / financial / biometric / children's / Art-9), masking rule, validation rules. Typed relationships with cardinality + FK + cascade. Governance + versioning. Mermaid ERD with optional PNG export. Markdown + CSV export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: acceptance-criteria-writing
plugins.description: Write, audit, or split acceptance criteria for a user story. Given/When/Then (Gherkin) default + rule-based + mixed formats. Systematic coverage (happy path + negative + edge + boundary + a11y + optional performance/security/data/integration). INVEST at story + AC level. SPIDR split (Spike / Path / Interface / Data / Rule) when story too big. Scenario outlines for parametric data. Mermaid coverage pie + split diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: planning-poker-protocol
plugins.description: Facilitate a planning-poker estimation session with anti-anchoring protocol (silent card selection â reveal â outlier discussion driven by extremes â re-vote â converge or park). Fibonacci default cards, reference-story calibration, timeboxed per item, per-item outcome log, session-level summary with follow-ups. Facilitation + documentation modes. Surfaces common anti-patterns. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: story-point-estimation
plugins.description: Story-point methodology â what points mean (complexity Ã uncertainty Ã effort), Fibonacci-progression rationale, team-specific reference-story calibration, velocity-based forecasting as range (mean / min / max / std), anti-pattern surfacing (hours-to-points, velocity-as-productivity, cross-team comparison, inflation). Four modes: estimate / calibrate / forecast / audit. Distinct from planning-poker-protocol (this is the criteria). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: story-mapping
plugins.description: Jeff Patton story mapping. Horizontal backbone of user activities (4-10), vertical sub-stories / tasks prioritized top-to-bottom, horizontal release slices with walking skeleton first then thickening releases. Reveals narrative gaps, over-detail, orphan stories, broken walking skeleton. Optional persona / platform / risk / dependency annotations. Feeds user-story-generator and planning-poker-protocol. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: example-mapping
plugins.description: Matt Wynne example-mapping for pre-dev story refinement. 25-30 min four-card workshop: yellow (story), blue (rules), green (concrete examples), red (questions). Ready-or-not verdict (READY / MARGINAL / NOT READY) with rationale. Post-session actions for reds. Draft acceptance criteria feed into acceptance-criteria-writing. Facilitation + documentation modes. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: story-splitting
plugins.description: Split oversized user stories using SPIDR (Spike / Path / Interface / Data / Rule) or Richard Lawrence's 9-pattern catalog. Vertical value-slicing with V-test gating (reject horizontal technical slices). Post-split INVEST check per sub-story. Recommended order (walking skeleton â risk-reducing â value â quick wins â edges). Flags when NOT to split. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: system-decomposition
plugins.description: C4 Level 2 + Level 3 system decomposition. Per container: technology, purpose, responsibilities, APIs exposed + consumed, data stores, deployment, scaling, tenant model, ownership. Per container relationship: protocol + purpose + synchronicity + failure mode + rate. L3 scopes to one container with typed components (controller / service / repository / adapter). Avoids L4 code details. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: adr-writing
plugins.description: Write, review, supersede, or index Architecture Decision Records. Michael Nygard format (default) + Y-statement alternative. Immutable once accepted â supersession chain preserves old ADRs. Status lifecycle (Proposed / Accepted / Deprecated / Superseded). ADR log with chronological index + supersession chains visible. Review mode flags stale ADRs + missing consequences. Integrates with traceability-matrix. Mermaid timeline with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: technology-evaluation-matrix
plugins.description: Evaluate â¥3 technology options (frameworks / DBs / languages / SaaS / libraries) using a weighted scoring matrix. 10 default criteria (fit / maturity / community / TCO / learning curve / integration / licensing / vendor risk / performance / security) + context-specific additions. Per-cell score + rationale + confidence + source. Sensitivity analysis varying top-2 weights Â±20%. Recommendation with runner-up + trade-off + risk + reversal conditions. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: architecture-pattern-selection
plugins.description: Select architectural pattern (monolith / modular monolith / microservices / event-driven / serverless / CQRS / service-based / space-based) based on team size + scale + latency + consistency + change frequency. Monolith-first bias. Evaluates against decision factors. Supports hybrid combinations per subsystem. Evolution roadmap with concrete triggers. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: ddd-strategic-modeling
plugins.description: Domain-Driven Design strategic patterns. Identifies subdomains (core / supporting / generic) with investment strategy, bounded contexts with ubiquitous language glossary per context (cross-context term differences surfaced), and typed context-map relationships (Evans' 9 patterns: shared kernel / customer-supplier / conformist / ACL / open host / published language / separate ways / BBM / partnership). Conway's Law alignment check. Mermaid context map + subdomain investment quadrant with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: architecture-tradeoff-analysis
plugins.description: ATAM-inspired structured trade-off analysis. Prioritizes quality attributes, identifies classic trade-off dimensions (CAP / PACELC / latency-vs-throughput / consistency-vs-availability / cost-vs-performance / coupling-vs-cohesion / etc.), scores options per attribute, runs sensitivity analysis identifying priority swaps that flip recommendation. Output frames as 'recommendation X, gaining Y, at cost Z' â not single-winner reduction. Surfaces non-obvious patterns (second-order, team-level, time-horizon). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: threat-modeling
plugins.description: STRIDE (default) or PASTA threat modeling. Decomposes system, identifies trust boundaries, enumerates threats per element systematically (Spoofing / Tampering / Repudiation / Information-disclosure / DoS / Elevation-of-privilege), scores likelihood Ã impact, maps to mitigations. Optional attack trees. Residual risk accounting. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: attack-surface-analysis
plugins.description: Inventory and analyze attack surface across 9 categories (network-facing / APIs / auth / client-side / supply chain / physical / human-social / side channels / admin-debug). Per element: exposure + auth + protocol + data sensitivity + CVEs + monitoring. Ranks reductions (remove > restrict > monitor > harden > patch) by risk-per-effort. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: authentication-strategy-design
plugins.description: Authentication strategy per user population. Selects mechanism (password / MFA / SSO OIDC-SAML-OAuth2 / passwordless WebAuthn-passkey-magic-link / mTLS / API keys / JWT / session cookie). Covers lifecycle (registration â recovery â rotation â revocation). Maps threats to mitigations. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: authorization-modeling
plugins.description: Authorization model (RBAC / ABAC / ReBAC Zanzibar-style / PBAC). Per resource Ã action Ã subject: allowed conditions. PDP / PEP / PAP / PIP architecture with central-vs-distributed trade-off. Common patterns: tenant isolation, delegation, break-glass with audit, GDPR purpose-based access. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: encryption-strategy
plugins.description: Encryption strategy across all data states (at-rest / in-transit / in-use / E2E). Per category: algorithm + key length + key management + rotation. Key hierarchy HSM â KMS â KEKs â envelope-DEKs â data. TLS 1.3 config, crypto agility, post-quantum readiness. Regulatory alignment (FIPS / PCI / GDPR / HIPAA). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: zero-trust-architecture
plugins.description: Zero-trust architecture per NIST SP 800-207 / BeyondCorp. Never-trust-always-verify. Identity-centric + device-centric + context-aware access. PEP at every boundary. Micro-segmentation. Continuous verification. Migration roadmap from perimeter to ZT. ZTNA / SASE / service mesh / BeyondCorp patterns. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: secrets-management-design
plugins.description: Secrets management: vault selection (Vault / AWS-Secrets-Manager / GCP / Azure Key Vault / Doppler / 1Password / Infisical), per-type lifecycle (DB creds dynamic, cloud credentials via OIDC federation, API keys rotated, certs via ACME, JWT keys scheduled), injection patterns ranked (sidecar > file > env), environment separation, CI/CD OIDC federation, break-glass procedure. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: conceptual-data-modeling
plugins.description: High-level conceptual data model â business entities + relationships in domain language, no technology or normalization. First of three modeling layers (conceptual â logical â physical). Mermaid ERD with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: logical-data-modeling
plugins.description: Logical data model â normalized + detailed but technology-agnostic. Generic types, primary + foreign + natural keys, constraints, referential integrity cascade. 3NF default. M:N via junction entities. Mermaid ERD with optional PNG export.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: physical-data-modeling
plugins.description: Physical data model â vendor-specific (Postgres / MySQL / MongoDB / DynamoDB / Cassandra / BigQuery / Snowflake) with platform types, indexes (B-tree / hash / GIN / GiST / composite / covering / partial), partitioning (range / list / hash), sharding, de-normalization, constraint enforcement, DDL output.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: database-technology-selection
plugins.description: Select DB class + product using DB-specific criteria. 12 classes: relational / document / wide-column / key-value / graph / time-series / search / vector / cache / analytical / ledger / NewSQL. Embraces polyglot persistence.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: data-governance-policy
plugins.description: Data governance: stewardship (owner / steward / custodian / consumer), 6-dimension quality SLAs (accuracy / completeness / timeliness / consistency / validity / uniqueness), classification-driven access + purpose-based, lifecycle (retention / archival / destruction), lineage + metadata catalog, change + issue management, GDPR / CCPA / HIPAA / SOX alignment.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: master-data-management
plugins.description: MDM for reusable entities (customer / product / vendor / location / employee). Architecture (registry / consolidation / coexistence / centralized), matching rules (deterministic + probabilistic thresholds), survivorship per attribute, integration (hub-spoke / federated / CDC), stewardship with SLA.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: data-migration-strategy
plugins.description: Data migration plan across 5 strategies (big-bang / phased / parallel-run / strangler-fig / CDC-plus-switchover) and 8 phases (source â target â mapping â execution â cutover â validation â rollback â post-migration). Pitfalls catalog. Reconciliation mandatory.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: event-sourcing-cqrs-design
plugins.description: Event sourcing + CQRS design (independent, often combined). ES: events-as-facts per aggregate stream, event store selection, schema versioning + upcasting, snapshotting, replay, temporal queries. CQRS: command vs query separation, eventual-consistency projections. GDPR via crypto-erasure / redaction / separation / retention.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: cloud-architecture-design
plugins.description: Cloud architecture for AWS / Azure / GCP / multi-cloud applying Well-Architected pillars. Compute paradigm, regions + AZ, network topology, identity, storage, managed services, landing zone foundation, cost optimization.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: iac-planning
plugins.description: Infrastructure as Code plan: tool (Terraform / OpenTofu / Pulumi / CDK / Bicep), layered modules, remote state with locking, environment separation (workspaces / directories / accounts), CI/CD OIDC integration, policy-as-code (OPA / Checkov / tfsec), drift detection.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: cicd-pipeline-design
plugins.description: CI/CD pipeline source â build â test â security â artifact â deploy â verify â notify. Tool selection, quality gates (unit / integration / E2E / SAST / SCA / container / license), artifact signing + SLSA provenance, deployment strategies (rolling / blue-green / canary / progressive / feature flags). OIDC federation.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: environment-strategy
plugins.description: Environment strategy: per-env purpose + data + access + isolation + prod-parity + refresh + teardown. Ephemeral per-PR preview environments. Data strategy (synthetic / anonymized / never-raw-prod). Cost management via tagging + auto-stop + ephemeral lifecycle.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: networking-design
plugins.description: Network design for cloud / hybrid. Non-overlapping CIDR plan, VPC structure, subnet tiering (public / private / data per AZ), routing (IGW / NAT / TGW), hub-spoke topology, DNS strategy, private endpoints for managed services, load balancers (L4 / L7 / global), CDN, hybrid (VPN / Direct Connect), service mesh.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: observability-strategy
plugins.description: Observability across 3 pillars (metrics / logs / traces) + events + profiles. OpenTelemetry default. Tool selection (Datadog / Prometheus+Grafana / Honeycomb / Splunk). Structured logging, metric cardinality discipline, distributed tracing with W3C Trace Context + sampling, SLO-burn alerting (not symptoms), dashboards per audience.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: disaster-recovery-planning
plugins.description: DR per service: RPO + RTO tiered by criticality, strategy from backup+restore (cheap, slow) through pilot-light / warm-standby / hot-standby to multi-region active-active (expensive, zero-downtime). Backup policy (3-2-1 + immutability). Failover runbooks + drills (tabletop / partial / full / surprise). Compliance (DORA / HIPAA / SOC 2 / ISO 22301).
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: api-design
plugins.description: Design an API by selecting style (REST / GraphQL / gRPC / WebSocket / SSE / tRPC / hybrid) against consumer profile + caching + real-time + typing + browser-reachability + team expertise. Per style: resource modeling / schema / RPC surface, pagination (cursor / offset / keyset), filtering + sorting + sparse fields, RFC 7807 error taxonomy, cross-cutting (auth + idempotency + ETag). Hands off versioning / rate-limit / webhook / contract to companion skills.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: api-contract-specification
plugins.description: Machine-readable API contract in OpenAPI 3.1 (REST), AsyncAPI 3.0 (events), GraphQL SDL, or Protobuf 3 (gRPC). Skeleton + operations + reusable components + RFC 7807 Problem envelope + security schemes + examples per operation. Contract-first. Lint rules per format (Spectral / Redocly / graphql-schema-linter / buf lint + breaking).
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: event-schema-design
plugins.description: Event schemas with CloudEvents 1.0 envelope + JSON Schema / Avro / Protobuf payload. Past-tense reverse-DNS naming, fact vs delta + domain vs integration classification, partition-key + ordering + idempotency-key, schema-registry compatibility mode (backward / forward / full / none), additive evolution + parallel-topic / upcasting for breaking changes, PII marking + GDPR crypto-erasure.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: message-broker-selection
plugins.description: Select a message broker (Kafka / RabbitMQ / NATS+JetStream / SQS+SNS / Pub/Sub / Service Bus / Redis Streams / Pulsar / Kinesis) on throughput + ordering + delivery guarantee + replay + fan-out + durability + ops burden + cloud fit + cost + ecosystem. Per broker: strengths / weaknesses / delivery semantics. Hybrid splits per workload class. Managed vs self-hosted explicit.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: integration-pattern-selection
plugins.description: Select integration pattern between services: sync request-response, async queue / pub-sub / streaming, saga orchestration vs choreography, transactional outbox, CDC, polling, webhook, async RPC. Anti-pattern checks (dual-write â outbox, 2PC â saga, sync chains, retry without idempotency, no DLQ). Idempotency + DLQ + circuit breaker mandatory for async.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: third-party-api-evaluation
plugins.description: Evaluate a third-party API across 11 dimensions â functional coverage, contract stability, reliability (SLA + status page + MTTR), security (SOC2 / ISO27001 / PCI / HIPAA / GDPR DPA), rate limits, pricing at forecast, data residency, support + docs, lock-in, exit strategy, operational fit. Weighted scoring vs alternatives including build-in-house. Risk register + PoC plan. Not legal advice.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: webhook-design
plugins.description: Webhook design (outbound / inbound / both). Event catalog + request envelope with HMAC-SHA256 signature + timestamp + versioned prefix, retry with exponential backoff + jitter + ceiling + DLQ, replay + redelivery endpoint, subscription-management CRUD + test + secret rotation, receiver idempotency guidance, versioning with parallel window + RFC 8594 sunset, per-endpoint rate limiting, observability.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: rate-limiting-throttling-strategy
plugins.description: Rate-limiting + throttling + backpressure strategy. Algorithm (token bucket / leaky / sliding window / GCRA / concurrency), layered scope (global > per-tenant > per-user > per-IP > per-endpoint), enforcement (CDN â gateway â service â data), IETF RateLimit-* + Retry-After + RFC 7807 body, tier + quota model, circuit breaker + bulkhead + adaptive concurrency, Redis / Envoy / gateway-native storage.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: api-versioning-strategy
plugins.description: API versioning strategy per style â REST (URL path / header / media-type / evolutionary date-pinned), GraphQL (@deprecated + additive schema), gRPC (package versioning + buf breaking), events (hand-off to event-schema). Breaking vs non-breaking taxonomy. Deprecation lifecycle (announced â deprecated â sunset â removed) with RFC 8594 Deprecation + Sunset headers, parallel windows per consumer type (public 12â24mo / partner 6â12mo / internal 1â3mo), multi-channel communication.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: component-design-documentation
plugins.description: Review-ready design document for a single component (service / module / library): purpose + context + bounded responsibilities, public interface before internals, collaborators (direction + protocol), data + state machine, errors mapped to external codes, concurrency + ordering, observability hooks, NFR targets (latency / throughput / availability) with strategy, security, config, tests, trade-offs + rejected alternatives, open questions. Hands off to contract / schema / error-strategy / config skills.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: interface-specification
plugins.description: Specify an internal code-level interface (module API / library / port) â signatures with preconditions + postconditions + invariants + error taxonomy (category + recovery) + time/space complexity + concurrency + idempotency + lifetime/ownership + stability label (stable/experimental/deprecated/internal). Mandatory examples: happy + edge + failure. Testability + alternative designs. Distinct from api-contract-specification (network APIs).
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: algorithm-design
plugins.description: Algorithm design pre-implementation: problem + inputs/outputs + constraints, â¥2 candidate approaches compared on time+space+stability+in-place+parallelism, chosen approach with loop/data/global invariants, language-neutral pseudocode, correctness argument (invariant / induction / preservation / reduction), edge-case catalog, worst/avg/space complexity, numerical + concurrency concerns, property-based + boundary + performance + fuzz tests, parallelization + out-of-core + streaming variants.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: sequence-diagramming
plugins.description: UML sequence diagrams via Mermaid â participants ordered by call direction, sync (->>) vs async (-)) vs return (-->>) messages, fragments (alt/opt/loop/par/critical) over duplicated diagrams, activation bars sparingly, notes for timing/SLA/assumptions, creation/destruction for dynamic participants. One flow per diagram. Shared sub-flows extracted. PNG export via diagram-rendering mixin.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: class-module-diagramming
plugins.description: Structural UML diagrams via Mermaid â classes / interfaces / enums with visibility, stereotypes (aggregate-root / value-object / port / adapter), relationships correctly distinguished (inheritance --|>, implementation ..|>, composition *--, aggregation o--, association --, dependency ..>), multiplicities, package / module views via graph subgraphs with layer + bounded-context rules. One purpose per diagram. Trivial members omitted.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: system-error-handling-strategy
plugins.description: System-level error strategy â 8-class taxonomy (programmer / validation / domain / transient / resource-exhaustion / poison / external-contract / unknown) with per-class strategy (fail-fast / 4xx / retry+budget / shed-load / DLQ / circuit-break / pin+escalate / fail-safe). Retry budgets with deadline propagation, breaker states + thresholds, timeout cascade rule, idempotency patterns, propagation + translation at layer boundaries (no stack leaks), DLQ per source, SLO-burn alerts, user-vs-operator messages, runbook coupling.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: logging-tracing-design
plugins.description: Component logging + tracing â structured JSON log schema (timestamp RFC 3339, level, service, env, version, trace_id, span_id, tenant_id, error), OpenTelemetry spans + attributes (HTTP/DB/messaging/rpc/exception semantic conventions) + events + links, W3C Trace Context propagation (traceparent + tracestate + baggage) over HTTP/gRPC/async headers, OTLP export to collector (avoid vendor lock-in), head+tail sampling (100% errors + slow, 1-10% happy), logâtrace linking, PII redaction fail-closed, retention tiers (hot 24-72h / warm 30d / cold 90d-7y).
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: configuration-management-design
plugins.description: Service configuration â key catalog per category (infra / business tunables / feature flags) with type + default + validation + scope + reload, precedence (flags > env > remote > file > defaults), per-category source (env / vault+KMS / remote-config / flag service), start-up schema validation fail-fast, secrets never in repo via External Secrets Operator + workload identity + rotation + audit, hot-reload only where safe, config drift fingerprint + alerts, feature-flag categories (release/ops/experiment/permission/big) with owner + removal plan + quarterly cleanup.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: dependency-injection-planning
plugins.description: DI planning â constructor injection default, setter/param/ambient where justified, one composition root at main/Program.cs/app.module.ts/bootstrap, lifetimes per dep (singleton / scoped-per-request / transient / per-tenant / per-conversation) with thread-safety rules, framework choice (manual for Go/Rust, Spring for Java, NestJS for TS, FastAPI Depends for Python, built-in DI for .NET), ports + adapters with deterministic ports (Clock / RNG / IdGen / HttpClient), lifecycle hooks, circular-dep prevention via seam extraction.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: work-breakdown-structure
plugins.description: WBS from scope + deliverables. Enforces 100% rule, mutually exclusive siblings, deliverable-oriented nodes, 8/80-hour sizing, depth-by-need (3â5 levels). Decomposition axes (deliverable / phase / responsibility / hybrid) consistent within branches. WBS dictionary per node (description, deliverable, acceptance, size, deps, risks). Milestones distinct from work. Intra-WBS dependencies + coverage matrix. Anti-patterns flagged.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: scope-statement-writing
plugins.description: Scope statement â purpose, SMART objectives with success criteria, deliverables with acceptance, explicit in-scope, explicit out-of-scope (highest-leverage section preventing creep arguments), assumptions with confirm-by dates, constraints (budget / time / people / regulatory / technical), boundaries (organizational / geographic / temporal / technical / segments), stakeholders + approval authority, scope-change protocol, coverage check with WBS, open questions. Distinct from business case / WBS / stakeholder map.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: license-compatibility-analysis
plugins.description: Open-source + third-party license compatibility analysis. Inventory via Syft / licensee / pip-licenses / go-licenses / cargo-deny / nuget-license, SPDX identifiers, 10-class classification (permissive / weak copyleft / strong copyleft / network copyleft / source-available / CC / public-domain / proprietary / dual / unknown), compatibility matrix vs distribution model (SaaS / on-prem / SDK / mobile / model weights), AGPL+SSPL distinguished from GPL, attribution + NOTICE obligations, patent grants, AI model/data licenses, risk rating Block/Review/Obligation/Clear, remediation options. Not legal advice.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: definition-of-ready-done
plugins.description: Definition of Ready (short enforceable pre-commit gate) + Definition of Done at three levels (story / sprint / release). DoR: value + AC + deps + designs + NFRs + data + size + blockers. Story-DoD: merge + CI + SAST + tests + observability + PO accept. Sprint-DoD: retro + demo + notes. Release-DoD: regression + perf + security + a11y + i18n + migration + runbooks + on-call + rollback + compliance. Team-vs-org layering. Waiver protocol with expiry. Living doc with quarterly review. Anti-patterns flagged.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: quality-gate-definition
plugins.description: Enforceable quality gates per pipeline stage (pre-commit / CI on PR / code review / security review / design review / build+sign+SBOM / staging / canary / prod / post-release) with per-gate spec (purpose, trigger, objective criteria, fail-closed behavior, automation, named reviewer, timeouts, waiver with expiry, evidence for audit). Risk-profile-aware tightening. Waiver process + volume review. Metrics (pass rate / time-in-gate / waivers / escapes / flakes). Distinct from DoR/DoD (gates are machinery; DoR/DoD are commitments).
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: release-planning
plugins.description: Release planning with Gantt + critical-path analysis. Cadence selection (continuous / weekly / monthly / release-train / milestone / hybrid) with trade-offs. WBS-to-release allocation (smallest-release-that-makes-sense; dependencies respected; risk front-loaded). Critical path named with slack per off-CP package. Explicit buffers (project 15-30% CP / feeding 10-20% / per-package contingency 30-50% on high-risk). External dependencies + constraints + freeze windows. SemVer vs CalVer. Freezes + dress rehearsals + post-release monitoring calendar.

plugins.name: vendor-evaluation-matrix
plugins.description: Weighted vendor evaluation across capability / reliability / security+compliance / TCO at forecast / commercial terms / implementation / viability / support / data residency+GDPR / exit-strategy+lock-in. Scoring 1-5 with evidence per score; unknowns marked [unknown]. 3-year TCO including integration + operate + change + exit + hidden costs. SLA expressed as our requirements. Multi-dimensional vendor risk (financial / operational / concentration / fourth-party / key-person). Exit-strategy per vendor. Not legal advice.

plugins.description: Test strategy + plan. Measurable objectives linked to business drivers, distinct test levels (unit / component / contract / integration / system-E2E / UAT / exploratory / NFR hand-off), environment matrix, objective entry/exit per level, risk-based prioritization (probability Ã impact driving depth), tools per level, whole-team governance, requirement â test case â result traceability, cadence + schedule + UAT, defect management (severity Ã priority + triage cadence + SLAs + RCA categories), metrics dashboards.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: test-automation-strategy
plugins.description: Automation + regression strategy. ROI-driven candidate selection, pyramid discipline (~70/15/8/5/2 for unit/component/integration/contract/E2E) with ice-cream-cone anti-pattern flagged, framework + tooling per level (one-per-level rule), shared fixtures + page objects, flakiness policy (detect/quarantine/root-cause/30-day age-out), CI integration (shard+parallel, timeouts, matrix, PR <10min), regression strategies (full/nightly/impact-based TIA/smoke+full/prod canary), contract testing with Pact, visual + a11y automation.

plugins.name: test-data-management-strategy
plugins.description: Test data strategy â synthetic (factories/faker/constraints) vs masked (redact/tokenize/pseudonymize/generalize/noise/synthesis) vs curated subset vs golden datasets vs third-party sandbox. Core rule: never raw prod PII in lower envs. Per-env matrix + masking per PII class (direct/quasi-id/regulated-PCI-SSN) + re-identification risk analysis (k-anonymity / l-diversity). Lifecycle (generate/seed/reset/refresh). Deterministic seeds for perf. Governance + 0-PII-incident target. Not legal advice.

plugins.name: non-functional-test-planning
plugins.description: Performance + security test plan. Sec: SAST + SCA + secret + container + IaC in CI; DAST nightly; IAST + fuzzing + pentest + red team; AuthN/Z tests; threat-model coverage check; vuln SLAs by severity; bug bounty; compliance-aligned (SOC2/PCI/HIPAA/GDPR/ISO27001). Not a certified audit.

plugins.name: team-topology-design

Cognitive-load assessment per stream team (intrinsic / extraneous / germane). Domain-aligned boundaries (DDD hand-off). Team API per team (purpose + services + contact + SLO + intake + interaction modes). Reverse-Conway when needed. plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

Anti-patterns (multiple As, all-Cs paralysis, same-person R+A bottleneck, generic rows, wrong-framework-for-question). Quarterly review + owner + version. Not a staffing plan.

plugins.name: change-impact-assessment
plugins.description: Change impact across seven dimensions (stakeholder / systems / process / data / training / compliance / financial). Classification frames (ADKAR / Prosci 7-step / Kotter 8-step / lightweight). Magnitude Ã reach matrix. Reversibility (reversible / mostly / hard / one-way) + urgency with 2x scrutiny rule for irreversible. Risk register with mitigations + owners. Sequencing + dependencies. plugins.description: Training + adoption planning. Learning-needs analysis per audience with ADKAR gaps. Adoption metrics on behavior (activation / retention / task success / support trend) not attendance.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: support-rollback-planning
plugins.description: Post-launch support + rollback planning. Rollback: path per deployment model (feature flag/canary/blue-green/rolling/big-bang) + automated + manual triggers + rehearsal MTTR measurement + comms within 5 min + blameless RCA. Non-reversible changes flagged with compensating controls.
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

plugins.name: communication-plan
plugins.description: Stakeholder communication plan. Matrix (who / what / when / how / owner) per audience (exec / leadership / team / customer-facing / external customers / partners / regulators / legal). Tailored style per audience. Reporting cadence (daily/weekly/biweekly/monthly/quarterly). Structured templates (RAG + highlights + risks + asks). Dashboards focused (5â8 metrics). Named escalation routes with SLAs. Bidirectional feedback loops with close-the-loop. Crisis / incident comms (speed > polish, single source, IC, post-mortem).
plugins.author: Sven Siertsema

Failure recovery break-glass paths (pre-recorded backups, reset scripts). Rehearsal cadence (content review T-1w, dry-runs T-3d + T-1d, check T-30min). Structured feedback capture (scribe + survey + 1-week close-the-loop). Accessibility (captions + screen readers + post-session content).
